    5228. ʿUwaymir b. Zayd b. Qays al-Anṣārī, Abū al-Dardāʾ: disagreement over his father's name; he is famous by his kunya. Some say his name was ʿĀmir and ʿUwaymir was a nickname. Distinguished Companion; first witnessed battle at Uḥud; devout; died near the end of ʿUthmān's caliphate, though some say later. [ʿ] [al-ʿAlāʾ b. Badr is listed under al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAbd Allāh.]
